newsitem.title: GREECE: BZW, SANWA BANK SET A $113ML FACILITY FOR GREEK BANK.
newsitem.headline: BZW, SANWA BANK SET A $113ML FACILITY FOR GREEK BANK.

text.p: The following information on a
structured sale and repurchase facility for the National
Mortgage Bank of Greece was provided by arrangers BZW
and the Sanwa Bank, Limited.
The facility of up to $113 million consists of three
tranches, each being in respect of a specific bond series, and
has an overall maturity of 4.0 years and two months and an
average maturity of 3.1 years.
The bonds to be purchased have been issued by the Hellenic
Republic and are denominated in Greek drachmas.
Barclays Bank will provide a swap to complete the
transaction and it will be risk managed by Barclays' Athens
branch.
The proceeds will be used by the National Mortgage Bank of
Greece for liquidity purposes.
Tranche A Tranche B Tranche C
Total amount $23ml $51ml $39ml
